show.description: A billionaire CEO, Manav, secretly fakes his own downfall to trap his rival, Karan. On his wedding day, he’s publicly humiliated as “bankrupt,” and his new wife Ritika’s family turns against him. Despite insults and betrayal, Manav silently endures, hiding the truth as he tests love, loyalty, and prepares a powerful comeback.
